messages.subject: Stan's issues #843-#848
parts:
These are issues for testing NaN as inputs into our math functions. I know it's not glorious work, but I'd love to have some help getting this tested.

I'm working on #843, src/test/math/functions. If you do pick one up, please assign yourself so we don't duplicate work.


I've already run into an issue with the first function I'm testing, Phi.

Q: What do you think you get when you pass std::numeric_limits<double>::quiet_NaN() into stan::math::Phi?
A: 1. I was expecting an exception or quiet_NaN.

Hopefully this is the only function that we have issues with, but that seems unlikely.



Daniel
